questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates real-world multi-tenant deployment patterns, including per-tenant isolation, feature flag management, and automated quality gates in enterprise environments.

## Key Concepts

- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines
- AKS with per-tenant namespaces
- App Configuration for feature flags
- k6 synthetic testing
- Azure Monitor logging
- Per-tenant promotion gates with automated rollback

## Code Example

```yaml
name: MultiTenantCanary
trigger: none
stages:
- stage: Deploy
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployTenant
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tenantA: { tenant: 'tenant-a' }
        tenantB: { tenant: 'tenant-b' }
    environment: 'aks-${tenant}'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy to AKS namespace'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(rgName) --name $(aksCluster)
                kubectl set image deployment/api api=$(containerImage) --namespace=$(tenant)
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: 'Fetch feature flags'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              appConfigurationResourceGroup: '$(rgName)'
              appConfigurationName: '$(appConfigName)'
              label: '$(tenant)'
          - task: Bash@3
            displayName: 'Run k6 synthetic tests'
            env:
              TENANT_URL: 'https://$(tenant).api.example.com'
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/k6-synthetic.sh'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Check health and gate promotion'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                HEALTH=$(curl -s https://$(tenant).api.example.com/health)
                if [ "$HEALTH" != "healthy" ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Health check failed for $(tenant)"
                  exit 1
                fi
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Rollback on failure'
            condition: failed()
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --namespace=$(tenant)
                echo "Rolled back $(tenant) to previous revision"
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: 'Log to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureResourceGroup: '$(rgName)'
              resourceType: 'Container Insights'
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a production-grade data-plane release with real-world constraints: cross-region deployment, canary traffic splits, observability via Log Analytics, policy gating, and irreversible rollback paths.

## Key Concepts
- Canary deployments with traffic shaping via Front Door
- Data-plane upgrade of a Redis shard and shard retirement
- Per-environment secrets from Azure Key Vault
- Compliance and change approvals via Azure Policy gates
- Post-deploy validation using Azure Monitor / Log Analytics and automated rollback

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
stages:
  - stage: CanaryUpgrade
    jobs:
      - job: DeployCanary
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            inputs:
              connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SP'
              keyVaultName: 'kv-${{ parameters.env }}'
              secretsFilter: 'RedisAdminPassword'
          - script: |
              # Create canary shard and apply upgrade
              az redis update --name canary-redis --resource-group rg-${{ parameters.env }} --set version=6.0
          - script: |
              # Route 10% traffic via Front Door
              az front-door routing-rule update --name canary-rule --front-door-name fd-${{ parameters.env }} --set routingRules[0].backendPool=canaryPool
          - task: AzureDiagnostics@1
            inputs:
              query: "Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)"
          - script: |
              echo 'Wait for 24h to validate metrics'
        # conditions for promotion/rollback are implemented in subsequent stages
  - stage: PromoteOrRollback
    dependsOn: CanaryUpgrade
    jobs:
      - job: Evaluate
        steps:
          - script: |
              if [ "$(az monitor metrics retrieve --resource /subscriptions/.../redis.canary --metric latency --aggregation Average)" -lt 100 ]; then
                echo "PROMOTE"
              else
                echo "ROLLBACK"
              fi
        - script: |
            echo 'Execute promotion or rollback actions and audit'
```

Why This Is Asked

Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr: none
pr:
  branches:
    include: ['*']
variables:
  azureSubscription: 'YOUR-SERVICE-CONNECTION'
  infraDir: 'infra'
stages:
- stage: Provision
  jobs:
  - job: Terraform
    steps:
    - task: Checkout@1
    - script: |
        terraform init
        terraform apply -auto-approve
      workingDirectory: $(infraDir)
- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Provision
  jobs:
  - job: DeployAPI
    steps:
    - task: HelmDeploy@0
      inputs:
        connectionType: 'Azure Resource Manager'
        kubernetesServiceConnection: 'AKS-Connection'
        namespace: 'default'
        releaseName: 'api-pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        chartType: 'FilePath'
        chartPath: './charts/api'
    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        connectedService: '$(azureSubscription)'
        action: 'getKeyValues'
        keyValues: 'perPRFlags'
    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: '$(azureSubscription)'
        vaultName: 'my-vault'
        secretsFilter: 'PR_$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)*'
- stage: TestAndHealth
  dependsOn: Deploy
  jobs:
  - job: HealthCheck
    steps:
    - script: |
        curl -sSf http://api-pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId).ingress | grep 'OK'
      displayName: 'Health check'
- stage: Teardown
  condition: always()
  jobs:
  - job: TearDown
    steps:
    - script: |
        terraform destroy -auto-approve
      workingDirectory: $(infraDir)
      displayName: 'Destroy infra'
```

```yaml
    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        keyVaultName: 'my-keyvault-prod'
    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION'
        configStoreName: 'myappconfig-prod'
    - task: AzureWebApp@1
      inputs:
        appName: 'myapp-prod'
        package: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/**/app.zip'

- stage: Validate
  dependsOn: Deploy
  jobs:
  - job: SmokeTest
    steps:
    - script: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh
      displayName: 'Run smoke test'
```
